webster.text: A solemn declaration of a fact, opinion or resolution.

example.quote: Not doubting the sincerity of gentlemen's protestations, I say, the mode pointed out in the Constitution is much better ; for, according to their mode, the Union would never be complete till the thirteen states had acceded to it, and eight states must rescind and revoke what they have done.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 25, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
